snippet.title: CUTOUT - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
CUTOUT makes its official debut at the FYNG Showcase during gamescom 2026.

Enter a handmade cardboard nightmare in this dark fairy tale horror hack-and-slash. Watch the official reveal trailer and get your first look at CUTOUT’s twisted world, handcrafted style, and eerie action.

✂️ Wishlist CUTOUT on Steam: https://bit.ly/46nGHrV
🔗 Learn more: http://linktr.ee/playcutout

Follow for future updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and more!
